title: The Overgrown Throne
text: A throne sits in a garden gone wild, roses climbing its arms and spilling over its back, the petals dark as wine. The air is thick with their scent. As you watch, slowly, every rose in the garden turns its face toward one of you.

options.label: The one the roses turn to takes the throne, as the garden wishes.

outcomes.text: Every rose in the garden kneels. Their scent heals, and it is hard to leave.

options.label: The strongest cuts a path to the throne, roses or no roses.

outcomes.text: The roses bleed red sap. On the throne lies a jewelled seed.
The thorns fight back with a sweet poison that lingers.

options.label: Bow to the empty throne, and go before the roses decide otherwise.

outcomes.text: A single rose follows you out on the wind. It stays fresh for a year.
